score: validateLayout scoring (DDLT unified, 0–1000 fixed cap) returns 1000 for a clean tiny graph (no penalties)
crossings: validateLayout scoring (DDLT unified, 0–1000 fixed cap) charges crossings less than a single 4-point edge bend
bend: validateLayout new hard-validation rules flags edge-bend-near-endpoint when the LAST segment is shorter than 10
obstacle: validateLayout new geometric issues flags edge-intersects-obstacle when an edge loops back through its OWN src node interior
port: validateLayout new hard-validation rules flags edge-shared-projected-port when a detached out-edge stub projects to an in-edge port
parallel: validateLayout new geometric issues flags edge-parallel-segment-too-close for long nearby parallel sections
label: validateLayout new geometric issues flags edge-label-overlaps-own-arrowhead when an overlay label covers its end marker
title: validateLayout new geometric issues flags edge-intersects-group-title when an edge crosses a group title section
